name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router: RSC, streaming, routing, caching, SSR/SSG, Server Actions; new apps, migrations, full-stack features, optimization.

Rendering: Server Components for data, computation, secrets; Client Components for interactivity/hooks/browser APIs. Static for stable content; Dynamic for personalized/live data. Stream large/slow pages.

Files: `layout.tsx` shared; `page.tsx` route; `loading.tsx` loading; `error.tsx` boundary; `not-found.tsx` 404; `route.ts` API; `template.tsx` remount; `default.tsx` parallel fallback; `opengraph-image.tsx` OG.

Examples: `app/layout.tsx` Inter, metadata, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, providers. `app/page.tsx` async Server Component, fetch revalidate 3600. `app/products/page.tsx` await `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`, Suspense, filters/pagination. `components/products/ProductList.tsx` colocated tagged fetch; check `res.ok`, throw. `components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx` client useState/useTransition, `addToCart`. `app/actions/cart.ts`: cookies, revalidateTag, redirect; validate Server Action fields, redirect confirmation. `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`; `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`; `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/loading.tsx`: parallel analytics/team slots. Photo modal: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx` intercepts; `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx` full page; root layout receives modal. `app/product/[id]/page.tsx` fetch product first; stream reviews/recommendations in separate Suspense. `app/api/products/route.ts`: NextRequest/NextResponse, GET query, POST JSON, 201. `app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`:
